caption:
Your website redesign now takes an afternoon, not a week you keep putting off.

Framer has been the drag-and-drop site builder that actually looks like real design software for a while now. But the update Product Hunt just put on its weekly leaderboard changes what you can do with it.

You can now drop an AI agent straight onto the visual canvas \u2014 the same one a human designer would use \u2014 and have it build out sections, write the copy, look at your existing site and tell you what's outdated, and reorganize your pages. You're also not stuck with Framer's own AI: you can plug in Claude or Codex and let whichever one you already trust do the editing.

The feature that matters most if you've been scared to touch your own site: Branching. You clone your live site into a private copy, try the full redesign there, and only merge it back if you actually like it. If you hate it, you close the tab and nothing changes.

There's also a new Community space where people are already selling templates and components they built \u2014 so a weekend project can turn into a small stream of income later.

Worth knowing before you get excited: the AI pass is still early software. Simple pages come out close to finished. A highly custom design will still need you to go in and clean things up.

Send this to the friend who's had \"redo my site\" on their to-do list for a year. Save it so you have it when you're ready. Full breakdown \u2014 link in bio.
